title: Promote knowledge for Microsoft-owned review skills
summary: Moves 29 knowledge articles and 56 companion samples used by Microsoft-endorsed review skills from the Community layer to the Microsoft layer, so they stay available when consumers disable the Community layer. File contents are unchanged, and the Agents corpus stays in Community.
key_points: 29 articles and 56 samples (data modeling, events, performance, security, UI, web services) moved to the Microsoft layer
Promoted knowledge stays available when the Community layer is disabled
Files are pure renames, with no content or sample changes
Agents corpus remains in Community next to its community-owned skill
Docs state that canonical skill knowledge belongs in the same shared layer, with custom overrides as the exception
quote: promotes 29 knowledge articles and 56 companion samples from Community into the Microsoft layer
